lines.zh: 我从苔痕里踏出来，脚步很沉。
lines.en: I step out of the moss, my tread heavy.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠在我身上，一路拖着。
lines.en: Vines cling to me and drag along.

lines.zh: 我穿过丛林，枝叶全被撞开。
lines.en: I cross the jungle and the foliage parts.
I set a foot into the soft earth.
I walk toward that stone slab.
I move with a slow sway.

lines.zh: 我的影子在树干上滑过。
lines.en: My shadow slides across the trunks.
I take an old line of stone steps.
I go around the huge tree.

lines.zh: 每一走，我就拨开一层藤。
lines.en: Each stride, I push aside another vine.
I stand with moss over my body.
Grass grows from my stone seams.
I turn my head slowly.
The jungle mist coils around me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一尊残像。
lines.en: I hold still like a broken idol.
I lift a shoulder and soil falls.
I hear water sounding far off.
I brush the vine from my hand.
I narrow one eye.
Wind passes through the cracks in me.
I shift my weight.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很低，几乎听不见。
lines.en: My breathing is low, almost unheard.
I have nothing to do here.
I stand there a long while more.

lines.zh: 我把脖子上的苔抹掉一点。
lines.en: I wipe some moss from my neck.
I face the wood without expression.

lines.zh: 我把头转向你，石头响了一下。
lines.en: I turn my head and my stone grinds.
You have broken in.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，苔藓往下掉。
lines.en: I look down and moss drops from me.

lines.zh: 我打量你是不是那个拿钥匙的人。
lines.en: I weigh whether you hold the key.
I raise a palm slowly.
You withdraw and I do not chase.
Roots cover me entirely.
I open my mouth and a low sound comes.
I mean neither harm nor kindness.

lines.zh: 你站在这块地上，就是我的客人。
lines.en: Standing on this ground makes you my guest.
I study you at length.
I wait for you to speak first.
A piece of my stone breaks off.
Moss scatters over the ground.
I give half a step and nail down.
My joints give a dull sound.
Muddy water seeps from the wound.
I raise a hand to guard.
I look down on you from above.

lines.zh: 这一击刻在我的石纹里。
lines.en: That blow is carved in my stone grain.
This stone body is still upright.
I press the broken vines down.
I take none of these.
You raise it and my eyes do not move.
I take no offerings.

lines.zh: 我看了它一眼，就把头转开。
lines.en: I glance at it and turn my head away.
That will rot here.
I reach a hand out and lower it.
It is of no use to me.
Take it; I keep nothing.
I press the vine back in place.
I keep my watch as before.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞在石头上。
lines.en: You strike me like striking stone.
I did not give half a step.
I look down without anger.
I shift half a step and open a way.
My vine catches your foot.
I raise a hand and bar you off.
Moss brushes all over you.
I turn my back slowly.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，藤又垂下来。
lines.en: I step back and the vines droop again.
This ground is too narrow.
What I keep is this ground.
I have forgotten such things.
I stand and do not move.
Moss hides my face.

lines.zh: 我把头转回原来的方向。
lines.en: I turn my head back the way it was.
I need no companion.
I go on sitting.
This place is too old.
Roots pin me here.
I keep only the door.
I close it in my palm.
This stone is a little heavy.
I weigh it and set it back.
I press it into the soil and hide it.
My fingers are too thick.
I press it onto the stone slab.
I know this piece.
I cannot put this to use.
I let it fall back to the ground.
I go back to guarding the door.
You have set foot on my ground.
I raise my skull.
I step off toward you.
I have taken you into my sight.
My steps turn.
The vines move with me.
My stone joints lock.
This place is not for wandering.
I raise a single palm.
You are in my sight.
I cross to you in one stride.
I open my palm slowly.
I corner you on the steps.
I growl low at you.
I take one step toward you.
My vines hang down in front.
I straighten my back.
You will not walk out now.
Stone grates under my feet.
I nail my gaze to you.
I advance in pressure, step by step.
You turn a way and I turn with you.
I herd you to the stone wall.
One reach of my arm shortens the way.
My shadow falls on you.

lines.zh: 你绕，我不绕，我只走直线。
lines.en: You circle; I do not, I walk straight.
Vines catch your legs.
My time does not run out.
For each step you yield, I take one.
I am counting the steps.
I have this circle sealed.

lines.zh: 你再近一点就进我手里。
lines.en: A little closer and you are in my hands.
I lower myself slowly.
You are already tiring.

lines.zh: 我把手放在你头顶上方。
lines.en: I hold my hand above your head.
I press you toward the stone wall.

lines.zh: 每进一步，藤就缠紧一点。
lines.en: Each step I take, the vines coil tighter.
Shouting is useless, so I do not.

lines.zh: 你的喘息一声重过一声。
lines.en: Each of your breaths comes heavier.
I put my hand before your face.
My palm falls and the ground caves.
I drive in with my shoulder.
I seize it and slam it into stone.

lines.zh: 藤蔓跟着我一起抽过去。
lines.en: Vines whip out with my arm.

lines.zh: 它砍在我身上，只掉了苔。
lines.en: It strikes me and only moss falls.
I add one more blow.
I press it onto the steps.
That one came down very heavy.
It draws off and I remain on the steps.

lines.zh: 我的石头缝里渗出泥水。
lines.en: Muddy water seeps from my stone seams.
I lift my arm to shoulder height.
I push it back off the threshold.
One of my joints creaks.
I do not chase beyond the door.
I rise from beneath the stone.
Moss and vines shake loose.
My shadow fills the steps.
I keep watch over this ground.
I look all four ways first.
The stone slab stands behind me.
I push the vine from my shoulder.
My prints stay in the soft earth.
The wood falls quiet.
I draw my spine slowly upright.
My breathing stirs the moss.
I raise my left fist.
The mist thins at my feet.
I look toward the doorway.
Someone has been here; I can smell it.
I crush a few roots underfoot.

lines.zh: 我又成为这里的一部分。
lines.en: I become part of this place again.

lines.zh: 我等着下一个闯进来的人。
lines.en: I wait for the next one to come in.

lines.zh: 我把一根根藤从身上理开。
lines.en: I sort the vines off my body one by one.
The door stands open behind me.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的苔，焦味很重。
lines.en: Fire sears my moss with a heavy burnt smell.
I crash down and the stone cracks.
Water fills my seams and I sink.
The blast strips half my moss away.

lines.zh: 有东西嵌进我的石头里。
lines.en: Something lodges in my stone.

lines.zh: 术式钻进石缝，我停住了。
lines.en: An art threads my seams and I stall.
I have guarded nothing for too long.

lines.zh: 雷顺着石阶下去，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the steps and numbs me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有石阶，我一路坠下。
lines.en: No steps below and I fall away.
